notes.title: New Demo build
notes.content:
Hello! It's been a while and I decided to really quickly make a new demo build with all the quality of life improvements I made along the way.

There is also very experimental controller support added. It kinda works for most of the game but it is akward and also ladders do not work on controller at all. You have been warned if you try to play with controller!

notes.title: Fix spelling and bugs
notes.content:
List of fixes:
-Multiple cases of bad grammer and spelling fixed.
-Multiple bugs and crashes fixed.
-Weird port problems to steam fixed (all of them I hope), like you becoming invisible in some rooms or dialog crashing the game.
-Capricote boss fight now doesnt lose its mind when you go into a corner.
-Game doesnt crash if you grapple something while also looking ahead.
-Void Grunt boss doesnt react to the cane (yes this is a fix).
-Clickers dont just stand there if they reach a ledge.
-Added extra highlights to the pullers in the first dungeon to show which should be hit.
-Easy mode now doesnt crash the game.


Note:
There is a bug in the game where the game stops working sometimes if you get hit by a box. Its an issue that I have been trying to fix for a while but haven't found a solution yet. Just in case someone finds that one: I am working on it!


If you would like to help with checking the spelling or finding bugs than I highly recommend joining our discord server: discord.gg/3mKCqmwVJp
